discovery: M3 engine source_spec() interprets 'Add {C}{C}' as unrestricted permanent mana and resolve() assumes nonland permanents enter untapped; both are incorrect for The Enigma Jewel. The engine does not implement its activation-only restriction or enter-tapped ability, so naive Mai and Zuko results would be misleading.
